Method of Attack: Ransomware attack involving data theft and encryption
Demanding ransom to not publish stolen data and to provide file decryptor
Impacted Systems: JVCKenwood servers operated by sales companies in Europe
Networks compromised by TrickBot, BazarBackdoor, and Anchor trojans
Attack Vector: Compromise via TrickBot, BazarBackdoor, and Anchor trojans leading to ransomware installation
Discoverer: Source sharing ransom note, FBI, CISA, NSA joint report
Indicators of Compromise: Ransom note for CONTI ransomware sample
PDF file proof of stolen data (scanned passport of JVCKenwood employee)
